---
title: "First Steps"
---

## Who this course is for

Curious beginners who want to describe everyday observations. No software or
computer is required; a phone or paper is enough.

## What you will learn

Describe a small set of observations and explain a pattern using evidence.

Start with [the observe data milestone](milestones/observe-data/index.qmd).
Follow its unit, then try the milestone challenge. Allow about 30 minutes.

This community course is ungraded. Challenges provide practice and self-checks,
not verified scores or certificates. This starter does not save progress.
